VMT.ItemUpdate.Title: Item Update
VMT.ItemUpdate.Hint: Replace an outdated item on scene actors with its compendium version
VMT.ItemUpdate.Modes.name: Name (exact, case insensitive)
VMT.ItemUpdate.TargetHint: The name or UUID of the old item to be replaced.
VMT.ItemUpdate.ReplacementHint: The compendium UUID of the up to date version.
VMT.ItemUpdate.QuantityNote: Quantity is preserved when the old item has a system.quantity field. Every other field comes from the compendium version.
VMT.ItemUpdate.Start: Fill in the fields and press Scan. Nothing is written until you confirm.
VMT.ItemUpdate.NeedTarget: No old item specified. Nothing changed.
VMT.ItemUpdate.NeedUuid: No replacement UUID specified. Nothing changed.
VMT.ItemUpdate.BadUuid: Could not load a replacement item from "{uuid}".
VMT.ItemUpdate.NoActors: No actors on scene match scope "{scope}". Nothing changed.
VMT.ItemUpdate.NoMatches: No matching items on any actor in scope. Nothing changed.
